messages:
Ava (Design): Quick heads-up — in the Batch Vectors preview the right-hand columns (relevance + export actions) get pushed offscreen at smaller widths. Screenshot attached. Can we make columns collapsible or add a density toggle?
Ravi (Eng): Yeah I see that. The current table has fixed widths for 'Preview' which forces horizontal scroll. A compact density toggle could switch font-size/padding and hide the absolute vector preview by default.
Maya (Product): Important: customers commonly export embeddings for offline reranking. We've had reports that exported CSVs truncate the vector field after ~200 chars which breaks downstream loads. We need a repro case + patch.
Jon (Eng-ML): I checked the exporter — we stream rows to the client and use the browser TextArea -> export trick. The truncation smells like a client-side serialization / textarea size limit. We can switch to Blob + stream saveAs which avoids innerText limits. Also offer base64 encoding option for reliability.
Ava (Design): Copy/UX notes: label for the toggle should be 'Compact rows' (not 'Dense' — customers confuse with density classes). Export option should be explicit: 'Include full vectors (may be large)'. Accessibility: the density toggle needs an aria-label and visible focus ring.
Sara (DevEx): Accessibility nit: table headers must be real <th scope="col"> elements, and the relevance column should announce updates (aria-live) when rerank finishes. Also keyboard navigation needs a row-level skip link to avoid tabbing through 100s of cells.
Maya (Product): UX question: if the user enables 'Include full vectors' should we block the export above a size threshold and ask to confirm? Suggest a warning: 'This download may be >100MB. Continue?'.
Ravi (Eng): Server-side we can add a safe default: cap full-vector exports to 10,000 rows for self-serve. Add a checkbox 'Override cap (requires approval)' for enterprise. We'll also add a progress modal and compute estimated size before starting.
Jon (Eng-ML): For the rerank preview table, propose adding arrows + delta text (e.g., +0.12) and a tiny sparkline for rank movement. For color, don't rely on red/green only — add a +/- sign and aria-label so screen readers get the change.
Ava (Design): Draft modal copy for the export warning — please refine tone:
```
Including raw vectors can produce very large files. By default we limit full-vector exports to 10,000 rows.
Toggle 'Include full vectors' to export raw embeddings for offline pipelines. Learn more.
```
Thoughts on CTA labels?
Maya (Product): Change 'Toggle' to 'Check' or 'Enable' — use 'Enable full vectors export'. 'Learn more' should open docs and say 'Recommended for offline pipelines only'. Also add a small badge showing estimated compressed size.
Ravi (Eng): I'll open a PR to replace textarea serialization with Blob streaming and add the server preview for estimated size. I'll also add `aria-live="polite"` to the relevance cell so rerank score updates are announced.
Jon (Eng-ML): I'll prototype sparklines and delta copy tonight. For data export format, let's offer two flavors: CSV (readable) and NDJSON (one vector per line, safer for very long arrays). NDJSON avoids CSV quoting issues.
Sara (DevEx): Good call on NDJSON — also ensure the content-disposition filename includes the dataset id and row count for clarity. Accessibility follow-ups: I'll run keyboard + screen reader pass on the compact mode and export modal.
Ava (Design): Follow-ups for design: 1) Add 'Compact rows' toggle in table header with keyboard shortcut (Shift+D). 2) Move 'Include full vectors' into export modal with clear warning and size estimate. 3) Update table responsive behavior: collapse preview into a 'Preview' chevron that expands per-row.
Ravi (Eng): Sounds good. I'll add server-side cap + estimate endpoint and a feature flag for the modal change.
Maya (Product): Can someone add a small unit test ensuring exported vector columns are not truncated and a regression test around NDJSON length handling?
Jon (Eng-ML): On it — I'll add tests for exporter serialization.
Sara (DevEx): I'll create an accessibility ticket and assign reviewers.
Ava (Design): Great, thanks everyone. Ping me the PRs and I'll review copy and focus states. :thumbsup:
design-bot: Created ticket #UI-4827 for 'Batch preview export truncation, density toggle, and accessibility follow-ups' and linked PR placeholders.
